body.name: \(Z_A,C_A\)
body.construction: For every \(A\subseteq V\) and \(U_A=V\setminus A\), set \(Z_A^{(a)}=X_{U_A}^{(a)}-\Sigma^{aa}[U_A,A]\{\Sigma^{aa}[A,A]\}^{-1}X_A^{(a)}\), with the second term zero when \(A=\varnothing\), and set \(C_A^{ab}=\operatorname{Cov}_P(Z_A^{(a)},Z_A^{(b)})\) for diagonal blocks and \(\{a,b\}\in E\).
